title: Using Tanner Spectral Reduction to Improve Multi-Layer Optical Lattice Routing for Hypergraph-Product and Bivariate Bicycle qLDPC Codes
summary: We characterize the Tanner graph spectrum of hypergraph-product (HGP) / lifted-product (LP) codes and bivariate-bicycle (BB) codes, informing qubit routing for three-dimensional reconfigurable qubit architectures. Syndrome-extraction routing depth on HGP/LP Tanner graphs reduces to a single SVD on the base parity-check matrix, using a spectral ratio $β_\text{HGP} = (1 + β_\text{base})/2$ where $β_\text{base} = σ_2(H)/σ_1(H)$ for the base parity-check matrix, and a diameter identity $D_T = 2 D_\text{base}$ where $D_\text{base}$ is the base Tanner graph diameter.
